title: 3343. Count Number of Balanced Permutations

examples.explanation: The distinct permutations of num are "123", "132", "213", "231", "312" and "321". Among them, "132" and "231" are balanced. Thus, the answer is 2.
The distinct permutations of num are "112", "121", and "211". Only "121" is balanced. Thus, the answer is 1.
None of the permutations of num are balanced, so the answer is 0.
